name: Original Rajubhai Special Dabeli
tagline: The Legendary Recipe Since 1987
description: Our timeless classic! Slow-simmered spiced potato mash stuffed in pav, drenched in sweet date-tamarind chutney, spicy red garlic chutney, fresh ruby pomegranate, roasted masala sing, and golden nylon sev.

name: Amul Cheese Blast Dabeli
tagline: Loaded with overflowing melted cheese
description: A cheese lover's absolute heaven! Stuffed with our spiced masala mash, smothered inside and crowned with thick melted Amul cheese grilled crisp on iron tava.

name: Butter Tadka Kacchi Dabeli
tagline: Traditional Mandvi, Kutch heritage style
description: Authentic Mandvi recipe bathed in garlic tadka, secret clove-cinnamon masala, sweet tamarind pulp, crunchy peanuts, and coriander.

name: Mayo Schezwan Fusion Dabeli
tagline: Fiery Chinjabi street punch
description: Spicy street fusion! Dabeli potato mix infused with creamy garlic mayonnaise and fiery Schezwan chutney, toasted golden in Amul butter.

name: Dry Fruit Shahi Royal Dabeli
tagline: Roasted cashews, almonds & raisins
description: Rich aristocratic preparation topped with roasted cashew halves, sliced almonds, sweet raisins, tutti-frutti, and pomegranate seeds.

name: Jain Special Kacchi Dabeli
tagline: Prepared strictly without Onion / Garlic
description: Specially prepared using spiced raw banana (kela) mash with traditional Kutch spices, fresh pomegranate, masala sing, and pure chutneys.

name: Peri Peri Crispy Dabeli
tagline: Zesty African spice kick with desi flavours
description: Crispy griddled pav seasoned with hot peri peri seasoning and stuffed with our signature spiced dabeli mixture.

name: Kolkata & Mumbai Pani Puri / Golgappa (8 Pcs)
tagline: Crisp puris with spicy pudina pani & ragda
description: Eight hollow crispy semolina puris stuffed with boiled ragda & potato mash, served with chilled spicy mint-coriander water and sweet date tamarind dip.

name: Delhi Style Sev Puri (6 Pcs)
tagline: Crisp puris loaded with nylon sev & chutneys
description: Crispy flat puris topped with diced potatoes, onions, chopped raw mango, mint-coriander chutney, sweet tamarind chutney, and a mountain of nylon sev.

name: Special Dahi Puri Platter (6 Pcs)
tagline: Chilled sweetened whipped curd explosion
description: Gol gappa puris filled with boiled spiced potato & moong sprouts, drenched in creamy sweetened curd, sweet date chutney, and roasted cumin powder.

name: Chowpatty Bhelpuri Supreme
tagline: Crisp puffed rice with tangy trio chutneys
description: Golden puffed rice mixed with crushed papdi, masala peanuts, diced tomatoes, onions, fresh coriander, and raw mango slivers.

name: Amritsari Samosa Chaat with Chole
tagline: Crushed hot samosas in spiced chickpea gravy
description: Two fresh golden samosas crushed on tava, smothered in rich spiced chole gravy, garnished with curd, pickled ginger, and tamarind drizzle.

name: Crispy Ragda Pattice (2 Pcs)
tagline: Pan-crisped golden potato patties with ragda
description: Twin potato cutlets crisped in butter, laid on hot white pea curry (ragda), topped with date syrup, spicy coriander chutney, and onions.

name: Rajubhai Papdi Chaat Deluxe
tagline: Crunchy wheat wafers with potatoes & curd
description: Crisp papdis layered with boiled potatoes, chickpeas, whipped sweet dahi, roasted cumin, and red chili flakes.

name: Rajubhai 3-Tier Club Sandwich
tagline: Triple layer vegetable & cheese grill
description: Three layers of butter-toasted bread loaded with cheese, spiced aloo mix, cucumber, beetroot, tomato, bell pepper, and our house mint chutney.

name: Bombay Masala Toast Sandwich
tagline: Crispy golden butter toast with potato filling
description: Iconic Mumbai street style toasted sandwich with cumin potato masala, capsicum, onion, toasted golden in Amul butter.

name: Cheese Chilli Garlic Toast
tagline: Gooey melted cheese with chopped green chilies
description: Gooey melted cheese spiked with chopped green chillies, garlic herb butter, and oregano on crispy toast.

name: Paneer Makhani Grilled Sandwich
tagline: Rich butter gravy paneer & bell peppers
description: Fresh cottage cheese paneer cubes simmered in creamy makhani gravy with capsicum slices, grilled in pure butter.

name: Chocolate Cheese Sweet Sandwich
tagline: Decadent melted chocolate & mild cheese
description: Warm melted chocolate hazelnut spread with mild cheese on toasted crust, served with chocolate drizzle.

name: Mumbai Special Vada Pav
tagline: Crisp spiced batata vada in soft pav
description: Mustard spiced potato ball fried golden, tucked in fresh bread with spicy dry garlic coconut thecha and green chili.

name: Extra Masala Pav (2 Pcs)
tagline: Butter griddled with spicy bhaji gravy
description: Twin pav buns pan-toasted on iron tava with tomato-garlic masala butter, coriander, and lemon splash.

name: Peri Peri French Fries
tagline: Crispy golden potato batons with peri seasoning
description: Crispy fried fries tossed liberally in fiery zesty peri-peri spice dust.

name: Cheese Loaded Fries
tagline: Drenched in hot liquid cheese sauce
description: Golden fries blanketed with creamy cheese sauce and jalapeno herbs.

name: Gujarat Special Cold Coco Shake
tagline: Velvety thick Gujarati chocolate elixir
description: Surat style ultra-thick cold cocoa drink crafted with Dutch cocoa, whole milk, condensed milk, served chilled with choco chips.

name: Kesar Badam Thandai Milkshake
tagline: Rich saffron & crushed almond cooler
description: Chilled milk blended with pure saffron strands, crushed almonds, pistachios, cardamom, and rose water.

name: Masala Chaas (Spiced Buttermilk)
tagline: Refreshing desi curd digestif
description: Churned cold buttermilk tempered with roasted cumin, rock salt, fresh mint, and ginger extract.

name: Kulhad Masala Chai
tagline: Brewed with ginger, cardamom & lemongrass
description: Strong Assam tea boiled with crushed ginger, cardamom, and lemongrass, served steaming hot in an earthen clay kulhad.

name: Fresh Nimbu Shikanji Soda
tagline: Zesty Indian lemonade with soda
description: Freshly squeezed lemon juice, black salt, secret roasted masala, and crushed mint with chilled sparkling soda.

name: Hot Gulab Jamun with Rabdi
tagline: Khoya dumplings soaked in saffron syrup with malai rabdi
description: Two warm golden milk solid dumplings soaked in cardamom saffron syrup, rested on a bed of chilled thick Malai Rabdi.

name: Matka Kulfi Special
tagline: Slow-reduced earthen pot kulfi
description: Traditional earthen pot kulfi infused with cardamom, saffron, pistachios, and almonds.

name: Royal Falooda Delight
tagline: Rose syrup, sabja seeds, kulfi & vermicelli
description: Layers of aromatic rose syrup, soaked basil seeds, thin vermicelli noodles, chilled milk topped with a scoop of kulfi ice cream.
